22template <typename T>
23inline T lerp_bipolar(const T in, const T out_lo, const T out_hi) {
24 return (in + static_cast<T>(1.0)) / static_cast<T>(2.0) * (out_hi - out_lo) +
25 out_lo;
26}

38template <typename T>
39inline T lerp_unipolar(const T in, const T out_lo, const T out_hi) {
40 return in * (out_hi - out_lo) + out_lo;
41}

55template <typename T>
56inline T lerp(const T val, const T in_lo, const T in_hi, const T out_lo,
57 const T out_hi) {
58 const T in_norm = (val - in_lo) / (in_hi - in_lo);
59 return lerp_unipolar<T>(in_norm, out_lo, out_hi);
60}

71template <typename T>
72inline T normalize_unipolar(const T in, const T in_lo, const T in_hi) {
73 return lerp(in, in_lo, in_hi, static_cast<T>(0.0), static_cast<T>(1.0));
74}

85template <typename T>
86inline T normalize_bipolar(const T in, const T in_lo, const T in_hi) {
87 return lerp(in, in_lo, in_hi, static_cast<T>(-1.0), static_cast<T>(1.0));
